description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different emotional states as perceived in a study on speaker anonymization. There are six slices, each corresponding to a different emotion. The largest slice represents 'Frustration' at 25.1%, followed by 'Neutral' at 23.1%, 'Anger' at 14.9%, 'Sadness' at 14.7%, 'Excitement' at 14.1%, and the smallest slice is 'Happiness' at 8.1%. Each slice is labeled with the name of the emotion and the corresponding percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
